Subject: Acme Corp - SOC 2 + Audit Logs - Post-call recap & next steps

Hi John / Acme security team,

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the action items we discussed:

Summary of pain points / goals:
- Audit log retention: you need 13+ months of tamper-evident audit logs for regulatory reporting.
- Evidence for SOC 2 / pen test: you want a clear bundle (attestation, control narratives, pen test summary).
- DPA & data residency: legal needs the updated DPA and confirmation of KMS options.
- Operational controls: visibility into token-level logs, access logs, and admin audit trails.

What we confirmed on the call:
- Redwood provides SOC 2 Type II attestation and can surface audit logs via the Console (default 90 days).
- Longer retention (1+ years) is supported on Dedicated/Private deployments; we can export logs to your S3 or an archival bucket for retention.
- Pen test summary and redacted evidence are available; full reports can be shared under NDA when needed.
- We have a DPA template that covers subprocessors and KMS/HSM options.

Next steps (owners & timing):
1) Marissa (me): share SOC 2 snapshot + DPA draft by EOD today - attached.
2) Acme: confirm whether you want log retention via export or a Dedicated deployment (decision by 12/15).
3) Neha: surface pen-test summary and redacted report; provide guidance on what we can share publicly vs NDA-only.
4) Rishi: confirm exact audit log fields and retention configurations we can support, plus any pricing delta.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-snapshot.pdf, redwood-dpa-v2.1.pdf
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C/acme-soc2-evidence

Would love to schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to go over retention options and DPA items - proposing Tues 12/15 or Wed 12/16. Let me know what works.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

- SOC2-Type2_Attestation.pdf (redwood SOC 2 Type II attestation snapshot)

- Extended retention: 1-7 years supported via Dedicated or Private deployments; we can also configure automated exports to a customer S3 bucket for long-term archival (we can push daily/weekly exports).
- Log schema (example): timestamp, event_type, actor_id, actor_role, resource, action, status, request_id, request_hash. (We'll share a sample JSON schema in the Hub Drive folder).

- The attached pen-test summary is redacted for public sharing. Full reports require an NDA and CISO-to-CISO exchange; we are happy to proceed if Acme is comfortable.

DPA & KMS:
- Our DPA includes subprocessor disclosures and standard European SCC clauses. We support customer-managed KMS keys in Dedicated and Private deployments; for hosted customers we provide at-rest encryption with vendor-managed keys or bring-your-own-key via KMS integrations on Dedicated.
